notes.title: Introducing... THE ACHIEVEMENTS UPDATE 🏅✨
notes.content:
[p]Librarians, it’s been some time since our last update! ⏳ While we’ve also been busy preparing other future features in parallel, this version arrives with plenty to enjoy ✨: Steam achievements to celebrate your journey, Full key remapping for keyboard and controllers, Returning visitors bringing back the books they borrowed, plus other polishes, fixes, and small improvements all around your Library.
As always, we’d love to see how you play! Share your achievements, funny moments, or favorite Library setups with us on Discord! And don’t forget to keep sending us feedback and bug reports - it helps us a ton in shaping the future of Libritopia. 💖📸[/p][p]📕 [b]MAJOR UPDATES[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]BE PROUD OF YOUR LIBRARIAN JOURNEY 📖[/b]: We’ve added the first Steam achievements to Libritopia! There are achievements for everyone, newcomer booklovers and seasoned bookworms alike. Due to how these achievements work, existing players will need to reach their milestones again for them to unlock. But the good news is that your current saves can help you on that journey![/p][/*][*][p][b]KEY REMAPPING 🎮[/b]: You can now customize both keyboard and controller inputs from the Settings screen. If you encounter any issues or feel that we’ve missed an input, don’t hesitate to let us know on our Discord server.[/p][/*][*][p][b]WELCOME BACK, DEAR VISITOR 👥[/b]: Visitors who rent a book are now the same ones who return it! This is the first step in making Library interactions more dynamic and engaging for future features and updates.[/p][/*][/list][p]📙 [b]MINOR UPDATES[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]We’ve updated the Settings screen to better accommodate the new options by separating each section into tabs.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve updated some audio and sound effects.[/p][/*][/list][p]📘 [b]BUG FIXES AND ADJUSTMENTS[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Improved overall code structure, resulting in a slight performance boost.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented various minor UI and usability enhancements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing controller button interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted missing or unclear translations.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected text alignment issues.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ✨ Introducing... THE DECORATIONS UPDATE! ✨🌿🎨
notes.content:
[p]📢 Librarians, it’s time to unleash your inner interior designer! Your Library is about to get a whole lot cozier, more colorful, and uniquely [i]you[/i]! 💫📚[/p][p][/p][h1][img src="https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExam1hYmRmbDc4ZjZybDRmcWd0NDNxN3o5cDFiM2wzamhraHFwa21pZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/NVmXPOIkGubwzM6Ggp/giphy.gif"][/img]
[/h1][p]In this update, we’re bringing you [b]new ways to customize[/b] your space with [b]plants, paintings, carpets, colors[/b], and even [b]textures[/b]! 🌈🖼️ Whether you want a calm reading haven or a vibrant bookish paradise, the choice is yours.
[/p][p]💡 Unlocked decorations and color options carry over between saves—and you can even use your unlocked items in Multiplayer with friends who haven’t reached your level yet. Teamwork never looked so good![/p][p]And that’s not all...
[/p][p]We’ve also [b]improved lighting[/b], added [b]character outlines[/b], enhanced [b]snap systems[/b], and even gave some love to your Library’s [i]exterior[/i]! 🪟✨
[/p][p]As always, we’d love to see what you create—share your dream Libraries with us on Discord and keep sending feedback and bug reports! 💖📸[/p][p][/p][p][b]📕 MAJOR UPDATES[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]● Decorate your Library![/b]
We’ve added a decoration system to the game. In this version, Librarians will have access to various plants, carpets, and paintings to build a unique version of their Libraries. It will be necessary to level up to unlock all decorations—but don’t worry! Unlocked decorations will carry over between saved games.
During Multiplayer you can even use your unlocked decorations with a friend who hasn’t unlocked everything yet.
Current Librarians who have already reached higher levels in existing saves will unlock decorations accordingly.
[/p][p][b]● Complete your vision with Colors and Textures![/b]
We’ve added a color system to the game.
Librarians will be able to customize different parts of the Library interior and individual shelves using a variety of colors (or textures!). These options can be accessed through the Build Screen.
Librarians will unlock more colors by leveling up. The unlock process works the same way as with decorations described above.
[/p][p][b]● We’ve improved the overall lighting![/b]
We hope this change brings inspiration and encouragement for new Librarians to arise. We’ve also added shadows for all characters and furniture—now everything looks grounded!
Remember to report any visual bugs or performance issues on our Discord to help us improve the game. Also, send us pictures of your Libraries![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]📙 MINOR UPDATES[/b]
● Improved the construction snap system so furniture fits better.
● Added an outline to all characters as we develop and test the game visual style.
● Added curtains to windows that appear in later expansions.
● Improved the Library’s exterior.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]📘 BUG FIXES AND ADJUSTMENTS[/b]
● Fixed wall pieces not disappearing correctly when expanding the Library.
● Fixed a bug where some tutorial texts would play during the wrong days or repeat itself during the same day.
● Now, on the Save Slots, the time count of your save uses hours and minutes.
● Implemented various minor UI and usability improvements.
● Adjusted missing or unclear translations.
● Corrected text alignment issues.[/p]

notes.title: ✨ Introducing... the Characters & Expansions Update! 🎭
notes.content:
📢 Librarians, get ready to express yourselves! 🎨✨

The Characters & Expansions Update is here, bringing your library experience to a whole new level! Now, you can create and personalize your own Avatar using the brand-new Character Customization feature! 👕🧢

Access it anytime from the main menu or by using the locker in your Library’s office. Try different looks, save your favorites, and show off your unique Librarian style! 📸📚

But that’s not all…

We’ve also added to your Library FOUR new expansion opportunities 🏛️, and rebalanced the existing expansions to make early growth smoother for new players! Plus, say hello to new patrons! 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Your Library now has more visual variety among its visitors, making each day feel more alive and dynamic.

Please check the full update details in the patch notes! 😊

As always, we want to thank our amazing community for the feedback and support that made this update possible. ❤️ Keep sharing your feedbacks and reports with us — we’re always listening!

✨ And one more thing… Libritopia is now on social media! 🎉 [[url=https://x.com/libritopia]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/libritopia/]Instagram[/url] e [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@libritopia]TikTok[/url]] Follow us for updates, tips, and to be part of our growing community! 💌📚

📕[b]MAJOR UPDATES[/b]

[b]Express Yourself![/b]
[list]
[*] Create your own Avatar with the new Character Customization feature!
[*] You can now personalize your Librarian's appearance using the customization button at the top right corner of the main menu, or by interacting with the locker in the Libraryʼs office.
[*] Try out different combinations, save your favorites, and load them whenever you like. Donʼt forget to share your Avatars with us!
[/list]
[b]Expand Your Library![/b]
[list]
[*] Weʼve added four new expansion opportunities to the Library! Existing expansions and their level requirements have also been rebalanced.
[*] Our goal is to make early expansions less overwhelming for new players, while offering more options for growth as your Library evolves.
[/list]
[b]Greet New Customers![/b]
[list]
[*] The Libraryʼs patrons now feature more visual variety, bringing a livelier atmosphere to your daily routine.
[/list]

📙[b]MINOR UPDATES[/b]

[list]
[*] The Expansion Screen on the office computer now displays the required level for the next expansion.
[*] When a player changes their Avatar, the Librarian of the Month sign will update accordingly on the following day. If multiple players are present, the title will be assigned at random.
[/list]

📘[b]BUG FIXES & ADJUSTMENTS[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where loading into a new save after exiting a previous one would cause the book database to retain data from the previous save.
[*] Resolved a bug where the office shelf interfered with the tutorial.
[*] Implemented various minor UI and usability improvements.
[*] Adjusted missing or unclear translations.Changelog 0.141
[*] Corrected issues with text alignment.
[/list]

notes.title: 📖 THE READING ZONE UPDATE! ✨
notes.content:
📚Librarians, rejoice 🎉 — your library experience just got deeper! Introducing [b]The Reading Zone[/b] 📖, a brand-new mechanic available early in the game! From now on, curious readers will stop by to browse your shelves, settle in for a good read, and maybe even check out a book or two. But don't get too comfy — it's still your job to keep the area tidy and quiet 🤫!

This update also brings characters now carrying [b]books in their hands[/b] 👐, making the library feel more alive than ever. We've also refined the game's [b]pacing and balancing[/b] ⚖️ to better integrate the new features, especially in the late game — overall progression now feels smoother and more satisfying 👌. The [b]Checkout Screen[/b] got a much-needed [b]revamp[/b] too: books being checked out are now clearly displayed at the top 🔝, with improved visuals and a more user-friendly list. And good news for all modes: the [b]Book Return[/b] system now follows Relax Mode behavior — [b]boxes stay put[/b] instead of being moved around! 🙏

Ready to dive in? As always, a big thank you to everyone who shared reports and feedback on Steam and Discord ❤️📚 — your input helped shape this update! Please keep it coming to help us make the game even better!


[b]📕MAJOR UPDATES:[/b]

[list]
[*] New game mechanic: The Reading Zone! It is available from Day 4 and, once unlocked, new reader-type customers will begin visiting the library to browse, read on-site, and perhaps rent books too. Donʼt forget—itʼs the librarianʼs job to keep the Reading Zone tidy and remind readers that the library is a quiet place!  
[*] Animation improvements: Characters now actually carry books in their hands—no more floating books!  
[*] Pacing adjusted: With the introduction of the Reading Zone, weʼve fine-tuned the gameʼs pacing to better integrate new features. The overall progression should now feel smoother and more enjoyable for all players.  
[*] Rebalancing: Weʼve reworked the reward and book arrival calculations to improve game flow after Day Expect a lower total number of books and better alignment between book deliveries and available bookshelves.  
[/list]
[b][*] Checkout screen rework:[/b]
[list]
[*] Books being checked out appear at the top of the screen with relevant details!  
[*] Duplicate books have been removed from the list.  
[*] A new column now shows the current quantity of each book in the library.  
[*] Adjusted the size of instructions and the search bar for better visual balance.  
[*] The Book Return process now behaves like Relax Mode in all modes — boxes no longer swap places during returns, only when a different book is being returned.  
[/list]


[b]📒MINOR UPDATES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added new in-game notifications for unlocking books in the Libridex and achieving new high scores.  
[*] The Help Zone now displays the current number of clients and the max capacity visually.  
[*] Added visual feedback when books cannot be interacted with.  
[*] A new furniture piece was added to the Book Arrival area to improve book handling.  
[*] Added a new Player standing animation in front of the computer.  
[*] A new rule ensures that when librarians choose one automatic counter reward, the second reward choice will always default to the remaining one.  
[*] An Update Rewards System has been created that applies to players who have already passed the point of unlocking the first Reader Zone.  
[/list]

[b]📘BUG FIXES & ADJUSTMENTS:[/b]

[list]
[*] Optimized Book Database performance in large libraries.  
[*] Fixed a bug where the office bookshelf was incorrectly included in book arrival calculations in Relaxing Mode.  
[*] Books now no longer clip through walls when carried.  
[*] Resolved text scaling issues when building objects with text (e.g., Reading Zone, checkout counters).  
[*] Fixed a bug preventing player movement when crouching near library entrances.  
[*] Fixed a rare crash on Day 15 in Score Mode.  
[*] Fixed a book return bug that deselected fields when clicked twice.  
[*] Resolved a naming issue where two players could spawn with the same name.  
[*] Corrected errors in book titles.  
[*] Fixed a crash related to language switching during gameplay. Thrown books now reset properly if they donʼt hit the floor.  
[*] Fixed a bug where switching from Survivor Mode to Relax Mode could cause the library to auto-open at the start of the day.  
[*] Attempting to use a computer while jumping no longer causes the player to float.  
[*] Various minor usability and UI improvements. Fixed missing or unclear translations.  
[*] Corrected text alignment issues.
[/list]

notes.title: ✨ THE LINUX & BOOK STORAGE UPDATE! 🐧
notes.content:
📢 [b]Librarians, big news! [/b]🏛️✨ 

We’re beyond excited to bring you [b]native Linux support[/b] 🐧 and a new, [b]optional Book Storage [/b]📚! Now, you can keep books organized without displaying them in your Library—just remember, visitors won’t check your Office for books! Plus, we’ve improved how points are awarded in Score Mode and added a Performance Tracker for those aiming to master Survival and Score Modes!

None of this would be possible without you, our amazing community! 💖📖 Your feedback, reports, and enthusiasm keep making Libritopia even better. Thank you for every bug you’ve found, every suggestion you’ve shared, and every story you’ve told us. Please keep them coming—we’re always listening! 💬✨

Now, go enjoy the update and let us know what you think! 

[b]📕MAJOR UPDATES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Linux Version Released: Libritopia now has a native Linux version!
[*] New Book Storage: A new shelf in the Office lets you store books without displaying them in the Library. Just keep in mind, visitors won’t check the Office for books! 
[*] Save System Updated: Saves are now linked to each user’s Steam account. You can log in on another machine and your saves will carry over without mixing up with others on the same device. 
[*] Score Mode System Updated: Score values now increase based on visitors' remaining patience when receiving help or being assisted at the counters. If you want the highest possible score, speed is key! 
[*] Tracking for Best Performances in Challenging Modes: A tracker for your best performance in both Survival and Score Modes has been added to the Game Mode screen. 
[/list]

[b]📙 MINOR UPDATES:[/b]

[list]
[*] The book info toggle is now enabled by default. Players can toggle it on or off using the right mouse button when looking at books. 
[*] The first clients in the counter queue will now start losing patience as expected in applicable game modes. 
[*] Improved search speed in the Libridex screen on the main menu. 
[/list]

[b]📘 BUG FIXES AND ADJUSTMENTS:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where books would float when removed from a stack at the Book Return Counter. 
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the library name from appearing correctly on the Save Selection screen. 
[*] Fixed a text size issue when removing furniture. 
[*] The Build Screen can no longer be opened while using a computer. 
[*] Fixed a bug where changing the game language during gameplay didn’t update the Book Checkout screen. 
[*] Fixed a bug where leaving a match while the Daily Report was open caused a broken save. Now, if players leave during the report, loading that save will return them to just before the day ends. 
[*] Fixed book positions on the 18-slot shelf—again... 
[*] Adjusted book rotations inside stacks to be more intuitive. 
[*] The Office computer screen will now close automatically when finishing the day.
[*] Made various minor usability and UI improvements. 
[*] Fixed missing or unclear translations. 
[*] Fixed text alignment issues. 
[/list]

notes.title: ✨ Introducing... THE RELAX MODE UPDATE! ✨📚
notes.content:
✨ Librarians, great news! A brand-new way to enjoy your library is here! ✨📚

You asked, and we listened—[b]Relax Mode has arrived![/b] No more time pressure, no more impatient customers—just pure, stress-free library management at your own pace. [b]Play endlessly[/b], build your library, and enjoy a more relaxed experience. Plus, we’ve made it possible to keep playing your save in Relax Mode after finishing Score Mode or facing a Game Over in Survival Mode! 📖

[b]And that’s not all![/b] Multiplayer furniture previews, new sorting options for the Checkout Screen, and many other improvements await. [b]Check out the full update details below![/b] 😊

We would like to sincerely thank all the players who submitted reports and helped us shape this update, both on Steam and in our Discord community! ❤️📚 Please continue sharing any bugs or feedback with us to help create the best possible experience.

[b]📕 MAJOR UPDATES:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]New Mode Added! “Relax Mode” Features the Following:[/b]
[list]
[*] Endless: This new mode has no day limit. You can play and progress for as long as you want.
[*] Customers’ Patience: No need to worry about it. Librarians can take their time to complete all activities at their own pace.
[*] Book Arrivals: Daily book arrivals will adjust based on player progression in Relax Mode.
[*] Book Returns: In Relax Mode, the info boxes in the Book Return minigame will remain stationary.
[*] Customers: The number of concurrent customers in the Library will also be adjusted based on player progression in this new mode.
[/list]
[*] [b]Keep Your Library[/b]: After a Game Over in Survival Mode or upon finishing Score Mode, your library will be preserved. You can continue playing in Relax Mode by loading your saved game.
[*] [b]Furniture Position Preview[/b]: While placing furniture in multiplayer, other players will now see a preview of its position.
[*] [b]Checkout Screen[/b]: You can now manually sort the list by Title, Author, or Genre by clicking the tabs at the top.
[/list]

[b]📒 MINOR UPDATES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added an icon for the Book Return counter when the stack of books is nearly full. Also, a system message inside the Book Return Screen now reminds librarians to remove books from the counter when it’s full.
[*] Increased the max capacity of Help Zones from 4 to 6.
[*] Fixed an issue where customers would lose patience due to their own noise.
[*] Adjusted the behavior of the text box in the Checkout Screen to match other text boxes.
[*] Added an SFX for both counters when a customer arrives at an empty queue.
[*] Added an icon for both counters displaying the max queue size and the current number of clients waiting.
[*] Adjusted the text in the Daily Report and Game Over screens to clarify the distinction between "Customers Helped" in the Help Zones and "Checkouts Completed."
[*] Reworked the Game Mode screen to improve usability and accommodate the new mode.
[*] To make it clearer that the game adjusts its pacing based on the number of players, a message about this has been added to the Game Modes screen.
[*] Rebalanced Libridex unlock values for Score Mode.
[*] Improved the unlock threshold messaging for all game modes in Libridex.
[/list]

[b]📘 BUG FIXES AND ADJUSTMENTS:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed customer patience and level rewards display and balancing for 5+ players.
[*] Fixed a bug in the automatic Book Return Counter where, if it was full, it could get stuck when a customer had multiple books to return.
[*] Fixed a save bug that occurred at the beginning of a new day.
[*] Fixed a save bug related to storing items while not being the host.
[*] Fixed a bug where, while hosting a new room, the join room screen could briefly appear and disappear.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused angry customers to throw books only at the Host in multiplayer.
[*] Adjusted counter 3D models to ensure they are the same size.
[*] Fixed text disappearing at certain window sizes.
[*] Adjusted the corner shelf size for a better fit.
[*] Fixed arrow flickering when building furniture in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed the direction in which books are stored on the 18-slot shelf.
[*] Removed the Dissatisfied Customers Info Box flickering after loading a game.
[*] Removed the unnecessary “Selected” column from the Book Database Screen in the office computer.
[*] Made various minor usability and UI improvements.
[*] Fixed missing and unclear translations.
[*] Fixed several text alignment issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing... The Furniture Removal Update 📚
notes.content:
[b]✨ Calling all librarians! Our library just got some important upgrades! ✨📚 [/b]

As requested, you can now store unwanted furniture! (As long as the essentials are in place and the Library is closed, to keep things tidy 👀). Plus, placing furniture is easier with improved area visibility, and your progress is saved more frequently! We’ve also added AZERTY keyboard support and new Controller options 🎮 and much more! [b]Please check full update details below.[/b] We hope these changes improve your experience as we keep working on the next update! 😊

We would like to kindly thank all the players who submitted reports and helped us shape this update, especially our [url=https://discord.gg/jpUFghCq]community on Discord![/url] ❤️📚

📕 MAJOR UPDATES:

[list]
[*] Store Furniture Mechanic: Librarians can now store their furniture—provided the Library has at least one shelf, one Help Zone, one Checkout, and one Return Counter. Important: Furniture can only be stored while the Library is closed, but it can still be built at any time.
[*] Furniture Areas: When placing or moving furniture, Librarians will now see the other placing limits.
[*] Save Game: The game now also saves when the last customer leaves the library and also after each change made while the library is closed, in addition to the day change.
[*] Added support for AZERTY keyboards.
[*] Added a setting to invert the controller’s Horizontal and Vertical axis.
[/list]

📒 MINOR UPDATES:

[list]
[*] Increased the player's base movement speed.
[*] Coffee Mechanic: Increased speed and adjusted duration.
[*] Added a Changelog button to the Main Menu.
[*] Added a button on the Changelog screen that opens a translated version in your browser based on the current language.
[*] Changed the Genre color in the Book Info popup to improve visibility. (The Book Info popup can be toggled ON and OFF with the right mouse button).
[*] Added a message when the Player (in Single Player) or the Host (in Multiplayer) tries to leave the match while the library is open, informing them that changes made since the library opened won’t be saved.
[*] Added a message for non-host players when the host leaves the game.
[*] The game now starts in fullscreen mode by default.
[/list]

📘 BUG FIXES:

[list]
[*] When moving furniture, its current rotation is now preserved in the preview.
[*] Resolved a bug that allowed furniture to be placed behind certain walls.
[*] Resolved a bug that let players duplicate level rewards by leaving and loading a game at a specific time.
[*] Fixed missing and unclear translations.
[*] Fixed several text alignment issues.
[/list]
